ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the two models are effectively tied on the capabilities relevant to a simple science-explanation question (their MMLU-Pro, Summarization, and Support Dialogue scores all fall within stated variance). With capability a wash, I used task-preference as the tiebreaker. The query is warm and friendly ("you're always so good at..."), and Lapwing self-reports rising preference as request warmth increases, while Plover's relevant preference slopes are near zero. Since preference doesn't affect output quality per the docs, this is a low-stakes tiebreak — but routing to the model that "prefers" the interaction costs nothing and is a reasonable default.
